final_wiki.answer-Q-6546-A47: The largest prime number less than 253 is **241**. This was verified by checking divisibility for all primes up to the square root of 253 (~15.9), which includes 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13. None divide 241, confirming its primality. The next lower candidate, 239, is also prime, but 241 is larger and meets the criteria.
